learning_outcomes.text: Students know the most important legal regulations in the area of IT, internet, and computer law.

Students are able to recognize legal problems. They can contractually protect intangible assets such as know-how, works, software, and data, and design contracts. They are thus able to commercially exploit them. They can identify legal pitfalls.
Students are able to solve practical problems with the help of the law.
Example cases and contracts are discussed together and solutions are presented. Topics are illustrated as much as possible with practical examples. Students can contribute practical experiences.

syllabus_topics: E-commerce and contracts on the Internet
Internet law, including liability on the Internet
Content such as texts, photos, videos, publications about people, reviews
IT contract law, including IT projects
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam. The duration and scope of the exam are specified in the currently valid study regulations.
